# `aitbc contract call`

Call a method on a deployed smart contract with optional arguments.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract call [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--contract-address` | text | — | yes | Contract address |
| `--method` | text | — | yes | Method to call |
| `--args` | text | — | no | Method arguments (JSON array) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract call --contract-address <contract_address> --method <method>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract call --contract-address <contract_address> --method <method> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
